name: Bauernhof Haslingerhof
beschreibung: The Haslingerhof farm is located in the municipality of Ebbs in Tirol. It is run as an inn and offers accommodation for holiday guests. The farm combines agricultural operations with accommodation. The location in the Unterinntal is a starting point for activities in the Alpen. The inn's restaurant serves regional dishes. The accommodations include various room categories. The establishment is structured as a typical Tiroler farm with an inn.
